title: Primary Care Medical Home
definition: The primary care clinic coordinates all of a patient's care — prevention, chronic disease, referrals — as the medical home. Continuity with one team improves outcomes and lowers costs. Every patient needs a home base.
patient_flow: Patients schedule by phone, portal, or referral; pre-visit planning reviews records and gaps in care. Check-in, vitals, and rooming flow to the provider visit — history, exam, plan. Orders, referrals, and follow-ups are arranged before checkout, with after-visit summaries and portal messages completing the loop.
code_demo:
def no_show_risk(prior_no_shows, days_since_last_visit, distance_miles):
    """Simple no-show risk flag for overbooking decisions."""
    score = prior_no_shows * 2 + (1 if days_since_last_visit > 365 else 0) + (1 if distance_miles > 20 else 0)
    return f"risk score {score} -> {'HIGH: double-book + reminder call' if score >= 3 else 'standard reminder'}"
print(no_show_risk(2, 400, 25))
teaching: Simple: the core idea in plain words — what it is and why it matters.
